.theatre-roles{font-size:11px;line-height:1.6;color:#667d88;margin:9px 0 0}.theatre-roles:empty{display:none}.theatre-hint{font-size:12px;line-height:1.65;margin:9px 0 0;color:#496b7a}
#theatreStart{margin-top:12px;min-height:37px;width:100%;font-size:12px;padding:8px}.theatre-panel.collapsed{width:190px;padding:10px 12px}.theatre-panel.collapsed .theatre-heading{margin-bottom:0}.theatre-panel.collapsed #theatreBody{display:none}

.theatre-mode #teachingBar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:8px 18px;padding:15px 23px;min-height:174px}.theatre-mode .word-block{grid-column:1;min-width:0}.theatre-mode .bottom-actions{grid-column:2;grid-row:1;max-width:155px}.theatre-mode .word-main.sentence{font-size:clamp(30px,2.7vw,42px);line-height:1.22}.theatre-mode .word-index{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#027c8e}.theatre-mode .word-sub{font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;margin-top:5px}

.theatre-controls{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;grid-column:1/-1;border-top:1px solid #cde4eb;padding-top:9px;flex-wrap:wrap}.theatre-controls button{font-size:12px;min-height:33px;padding:6px 11px;box-shadow:none;border-radius:9px}.theatre-controls .icon{width:15px;height:15px}.theatre-control-divider{width:1px;height:20px;background:#b9d9e2;margin:0 2px}.theatre-controls #theatreNext{margin-left:auto;min-width:99px}.theatre-controls #theatrePractice[aria-pressed=true]{background:#deeffc;color:#145d8c;border-color:#8db6d3}
.theatre-started #scene{bottom:215px}.theatre-mode .gesture-hint{display:none}.theatre-mode #storyCaption{top:103px;font-size:13px;padding:8px 16px;max-width:45vw;text-align:center}

<body>
<svg class="defs" aria-hidden="true"><defs>
<symbol id="i-home" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="m3 11 9-8 9 8M5 10v11h14V10M9 21v-7h6v7"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-play" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="m8 4 12 8-12 8z"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-pause" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M8 4v16M16 4v16"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-reset" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 10a9 9 0 1 1 3 9M3 3v7h7"/></symbol>

<symbol id="i-eye" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M2 12s4-7 10-7 10 7 10 7-4 7-10 7-10-7-10-7"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-full" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M8 3H3v5M16 3h5v5M3 16v5h5M21 16v5h-5"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-guide" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 4h7l2 2 2-2h7v15h-7l-2 2-2-2H3zM12 6v15M6 8h3M6 12h3M15 8h3M15 12h3"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-map" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="m3 5 6-2 6 2 6-2v16l-6 2-6-2-6 2zM9 3v16M15 5v16"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-info" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M12 11v6M12 7v1"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-arrow" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 12h16m-6-6 6 6-6 6"/></symbol>
</defs></svg>
<div id="creator">课件制作：小小小白</div>
<header>
 <div class="brand"><div class="brand-mark"><svg class="icon"><use href="#i-home"/></svg></div><div><div class="brand-cn">走进我们的社区</div><div class="brand-en">OUR COMMUNITY</div></div></div>
 <nav aria-label="课堂模式"><button data-mode="explore" class="active" aria-pressed="true"><span class="num">01</span>自由探索</button><button data-mode="mission" aria-pressed="false"><span class="num">02</span>找一找</button><button data-mode="theatre" aria-pressed="false"><span class="num">03</span>社区小剧场</button></nav>
 <div class="header-tools"><button class="quiet iconbtn" id="tourBtn" aria-label="播放社区导览"><svg class="icon"><use href="#i-play"/></svg>导览</button><button class="quiet iconbtn" id="helpBtn" aria-label="打开教学辅助"><svg class="icon"><use href="#i-guide"/></svg>教学辅助</button><button class="quiet round" id="cinemaBtn" aria-label="收起教学控件" title="收起教学控件"><svg class="icon"><use href="#i-eye"/></svg></button><button class="quiet round" id="aboutBtn" aria-label="关于课件" title="关于课件"><svg class="icon"><use href="#i-info"/></svg></button></div>
</header>
<main>
 <div id="scene" role="group" aria-label="可旋转和点击的三维社区，包含公园、操场、医院、商店、公共卫生间、公交站、图书馆和博物馆"></div>
 <div id="intro"><div class="unit-tag">四年级 · UNIT 3</div><h1>Our community</h1><p>点击地点，观察与表达。</p></div>
 <div class="scene-controls"><button class="iconbtn" id="homeBtn"><svg class="icon"><use href="#i-reset"/></svg>全景</button><button class="iconbtn" id="placesBtn" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="placeDrawer"><svg class="icon"><use href="#i-map"/></svg>地点</button><button class="round" id="fullscreenBtn" aria-label="全屏展示"><svg class="icon"><use href="#i-full"/></svg></button></div>
 <div id="placeDrawer" hidden><div class="drawer-head"><span>今天去哪里？</span><button id="closePlaces" class="quiet compact" aria-label="关闭地点选择">×</button></div><div id="placeChoices" class="drawer-grid"></div><p class="drawer-note">可点选场景中的建筑，也可在这里选择。</p></div>
 <section id="theatrePanel" class="theatre-panel" aria-labelledby="theatreTitle" hidden>
  <div class="theatre-heading"><h2 id="theatreTitle">社区小剧场</h2><button id="theatreCollapse" class="quiet compact" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="theatreBody" aria-label="收起剧目面板" title="收起剧目面板">−</button></div>
  <div id="theatreBody"><label class="sr-only" for="theatreSelect">选择社区短剧</label><select id="theatreSelect"></select><p id="theatreRoles" class="theatre-roles"></p><p id="theatreHint" class="theatre-hint" role="status">选一出短剧，听对话，再试着接话。</p><button id="theatreStart" class="primary iconbtn"><svg class="icon"><use href="#i-play"/></svg>开始表演</button></div>
 </section>
 <div id="missionPanel" class="mission-card" hidden><h2 id="missionTitle">今天去哪里？</h2><p id="missionHint"></p><div id="missionFeedback" class="mission-feedback" role="status"></div><div class="mission-buttons"><button id="revealMission">老师揭示</button><button id="nextMission" class="primary">换一个任务 →</button></div></div>
 <div id="storyCaption" role="status" hidden></div>
 <div id="navPad" class="nav-pad" aria-label="旋转社区视角"><button data-rotate="-0.35" aria-label="向左旋转" title="向左旋转">↶</button><button data-rotate="0.35" aria-label="向右旋转" title="向右旋转">↷</button></div>
 <div id="tourBadge" class="tour-badge" hidden><span class="tour-dot"></span><span id="tourLabel">社区导览</span><button id="pauseTour">暂停</button><button id="stopTour">结束</button><div class="tour-line"><span id="tourProgress"></span></div></div>
 <div class="corner-mark">PLACES WE LIVE IN<span>原创场景 · 单元教学样例</span></div><div class="gesture-hint">左键 / 单指旋转 · 右键 / 双指平移 · 滚轮缩放</div>
 <section id="teachingBar" aria-label="当前教学内容"><div class="word-block" aria-live="polite"><div class="word-meta"><span id="wordIndex" class="word-index">WELCOME TO OUR COMMUNITY</span><span id="wordCategory" class="word-category"></span><div id="levelSwitch" class="level-switch" aria-label="英语表达层次" hidden><button data-level="word" class="active">地点</button><button data-level="use">用途</button><button data-level="number">数量</button></div></div><h2 id="mainText" class="word-main">Welcome to our community.</h2><p id="subText" class="word-sub">点击一个地点，开始今天的社区之旅。</p></div><div class="bottom-actions"><div id="sceneActions" class="scene-actions" aria-label="本站互动" hidden></div><button id="speakBtn" class="round" aria-label="播放当前英语示范音"><svg class="icon"><use href="#i-sound"/></svg></button><button id="wordsBtn" class="quiet compact" aria-pressed="true">隐藏词句</button><div id="activityArea" hidden><div class="activity-controls"><button id="playBtn" class="primary iconbtn"><svg class="icon"><use href="#i-play"/></svg><span>暂停</span></button><button id="resetActivityBtn" class="round" aria-label="复位当前动画"><svg class="icon"><use href="#i-reset"/></svg></button><label class="scrub-wrap"><span hidden>动画进度</span><input id="activityScrub" type="range" min="0" max="1000" value="0" aria-label="动画进度"></label></div><p id="activityNote" class="intent-note">点击即开始 · 随时暂停讲解</p></div><button id="startBtn" class="primary iconbtn">从公交站出发<svg class="icon"><use href="#i-arrow"/></svg></button></div><div id="theatreChoices" class="theatre-choices" role="group" aria-label="选择下一句英语" hidden></div><div id="theatreControls" class="theatre-controls" aria-label="短剧播放与分角色表演" hidden><button id="theatrePractice" class="compact" aria-pressed="false" title="每句停下来，由学生分角色朗读">分角色演</button><span class="theatre-control-divider" aria-hidden="true"></span><button id="theatrePause" class="compact">暂停</button><button id="theatreReplay" class="compact iconbtn"><svg class="icon"><use href="#i-sound"/></svg>重听</button><button id="theatreReset" class="quiet compact iconbtn"><svg class="icon"><use href="#i-reset"/></svg>重演</button><button id="theatreNext" class="primary compact iconbtn" title="说完后点击继续，也可轻点场景画面">下一句<svg class="icon"><use href="#i-arrow"/></svg></button></div></section>
 <div id="loading"><svg class="icon load-icon"><use href="#i-home"/></svg>正在打开社区的大门…<div class="loading-track"></div></div>
 <div id="loadError" role="alert" hidden><h2>三维场景暂时无法显示</h2><p id="errorMessage">请用支持 WebGL 的桌面浏览器打开课件。</p><button id="retryBtn" class="primary">重新打开场景</button></div>
 <div id="toast" role="status" hidden></div>
</main>
<dialog id="helpDialog" aria-labelledby="helpTitle"><button class="close-dialog" data-close="helpDialog" aria-label="关闭教学辅助">×</button><div class="eyebrow">TEACHER'S COMPANION</div><h2 id="helpTitle">教学辅助</h2><div class="tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="辅助内容"><button data-tab="guide" class="active" role="tab" aria-selected="true" aria-controls="tab-guide">使用提示</button><button data-tab="settings" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="tab-settings">画面与声音</button><button data-tab="phonics" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="tab-phonics">拼读补充</button><button data-tab="reading" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="tab-reading">阅读延伸</button></div>
 <section id="tab-guide" role="tabpanel"><div class="guide-step"><b>自由探索 · 换个角度认识地点</b><p>点击地图中的建筑，镜头靠近这一个地点。左键或单指拖动可环绕观察，地面以上的各个方向都能查看。用“地点 / 用途 / 数量”切换英语表达；每栋建筑分别记住自己的选择，新地点默认显示地点名称。隐藏词句后先让学生说。</p></div><div class="guide-step"><b>找一找 · 为生活选择地点</b><p>根据“想看书、想运动、想买东西”等需求在地图上寻找。选中合适地点后一起观察，用完整短句回答。数数任务由老师揭示真实数量，不设分数或排行榜。</p></div><div class="guide-step"><b>社区小剧场 · 听一听，接着说</b><p>选择短剧后开始表演，镜头停稳后人物才开口。每句说完都会停下来，点击场景画面或“下一句”继续；拖动只旋转视角。遇到接话选择时，先和学生讨论，再选一句推动剧情。“分角色演”由学生朗读，“重听”可播放当前英语。</p></div><div class="guide-tip">先听一遍，再请两组同学分角色演。可隐藏中文，让学生结合地点和人物动作理解台词。</div><p class="small muted" style="margin-top:16px">左键或单指拖动旋转；右键或双指拖动平移；滚轮缩放。右下角两个按钮也可转动视角。<span class="kbd">空格</span> 暂停/继续，<span class="kbd">Esc</span> 收起面板或退出导览。</p></section>
 <section id="tab-settings" role="tabpanel" hidden><div class="settings-grid"><div class="setting"><label>显示中文辅助<input id="chineseToggle" type="checkbox" checked></label><small>按需显示释义和短句中文。</small></div><div class="setting"><label>显示建筑招牌<input id="labelsToggle" type="checkbox" checked></label><small>在所有课堂模式中显示英文地点名称。</small></div><div class="setting"><label>环境轻微动画<input id="motionToggle" type="checkbox" checked></label><small>关闭减少环境干扰，地点互动仍正常进行。</small></div><div class="setting"><label for="qualitySelect">画面质量</label><select id="qualitySelect"><option value="high">精致 · 完整光影</option><option value="low">流畅 · 适合旧电脑</option></select></div></div><div class="voice-manager"><h3>课堂配音</h3><p id="voiceStatus"></p><label class="file-label">导入配音包<input id="voiceImport" type="file" accept=".json,application/json"></label><p class="small muted">可导入自己的配音包，替换课堂示范音。</p><div id="voiceControls" class="settings-grid" hidden><div class="setting"><label for="voiceRate">英语语速</label><select id="voiceRate"><option value="0.7">跟读慢速</option><option value="0.8" selected>小学生慢速</option><option value="0.9">稍慢</option><option value="1">原速</option></select></div><div class="setting"><label>选中后自动朗读<input id="autoSpeak" type="checkbox"></label><small>选中地点后播放对应英语词句。</small></div></div></div><p class="save-note" id="saveNote">显示和声音偏好仅保存在本机浏览器。</p></section>
 <section id="tab-phonics" role="tabpanel" hidden><p class="muted small">按需使用的 ck 拼读补充</p><div class="phonics-pattern">ck <span>/k/</span></div><div id="phonicsWords" class="phonics-words"></div><p class="small muted">点词听读，再观察共同的字母组合。</p></section>
 <section id="tab-reading" role="tabpanel" hidden><div class="row spread"><span class="eyebrow">MY FAVOURITE PLACE</span><button id="focusMuseum" class="compact">看看博物馆</button></div><div class="reading-box"><p id="readingText"></p></div><div class="row"><button id="readPassage" class="primary iconbtn"><svg class="icon"><use href="#i-sound"/></svg>听短文</button><button id="readingTranslationBtn" class="compact">显示中文</button></div><p id="readingTranslation" class="small muted" hidden style="margin-top:16px"></p><p class="small muted" style="margin-top:18px">请学生替换地点和活动，介绍自己的社区。</p></section>
</dialog>
<dialog id="aboutDialog" aria-labelledby="aboutTitle"><button class="close-dialog" data-close="aboutDialog" aria-label="关闭关于课件">×</button><div class="eyebrow">ABOUT THIS COMMUNITY</div><h2 id="aboutTitle">关于课件</h2><div class="brand-profile"><img class="avatar" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="小小小白头像"><div><strong>小小小白</strong><p>课件制作：小小小白</p></div></div><div class="platforms"><div><img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," alt="小红书">小红书 · 小小小白</div><div><img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," alt="抖音">抖音 · 小小小白</div></div><p>走进我们的社区 · Our Community</p><p class="muted">认识社区地点，在观察、寻找和小剧场中练习英语表达。</p></dialog>
